jobs.description:
Our client operates in the logistics sector, specializing in warehouse operations and inventory management. The company focuses on the efficient handling, storage and distribution of goods. Quality, accuracy and safety are essential in its daily operations. Employees work together to ensure smooth inbound and outbound processes. You will join a professional warehouse environment where teamwork and efficiency are key.
Jobomschrijving

Looking for an opportunity where you can make a visible impact and help shape a growing operation from the ground up? Our client Segex is a new and expanding logistics organization based in Wommelgem, specializing in the storage, packaging, and distribution of healthcare and pharmaceutical products.

As part of an international group this company manages the flow of products from global manufacturers to customers across Central- and South- America, Europe and Asia. The Belgian operation was launched recently and currently employs a small team of around eight people, creating a unique opportunity to join a business in an exciting growth phase.

As Warehouse Supervisor, you will take ownership of the day-to-day warehouse operations and lead the Belgian warehouse team. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while helping build processes and structure within a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the warehouse team, ensuring smooth daily operations.
• Manage inbound, outbound, picking, packing, inventory, and stock accuracy activities.
• Monitor warehouse KPIs and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
• Act as the local key user for the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Coordinate staffing, holidays, absences, and workforce planning in collaboration with local management.
• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and operational procedures.
• Work closely with the international operations team in headquarters and support the continued growth of the Belgian site.

You enjoy being present on the warehouse floor, taking ownership, and motivating people to achieve operational goals.

Who You Are?

• A natural team leader who leads by example and communicates clearly.
• Structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working in a dynamic international logistics environment.
• Focused on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
• Proactive and capable of making operational decisions independently.
must haves

• Minimum 3 years of experience within warehouse or logistics operations.
• Proven experience as a Warehouse Supervisor, Team Leader, or Warehouse Coordinator.
• Experience managing and motivating operational teams.
• Strong understanding of inbound, outbound, inventory management, and warehouse KPIs.
• Hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Good knowledge of international logistics and imported goods flows.
• Professional proficiency in English and Spanish. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset

jobs.occupation: CONTENT CREATOR BEAUTY AND LIFESTYLE – NL/FR/ENG (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Deluge is seeking a creative and hands-on Content Creator to strengthen our brand presence and tell our story across digital channels. 
 

 As our Content Creator, you will:
 
 

• Develop and execute the content strategy for Deluge across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms. 

• Create and edit high-quality photo and video content for campaigns, product launches, and day-to-day storytelling. 

• Coordinate and manage content creation for digital platforms, newsletters, PR, and print materials. 

• Collaborate with external parties to create high-end content. 

• Collaborate closely with the founders to ensure all content aligns with Deluge’s tone, values, and aesthetic. 

• Monitor trends and translate them into creative concepts for luxury audiences. 

• Manage and plan the content calendar and publish posts consistently. 

• Create website visuals, and other marketing materials, such as newsletters. 

• Support influencer collaborations and event coverage. 

• Prepare shoots for upcoming campaigns. 

•  Organize and promote events, brand activations, and partnerships. 
 

• You have at least 3-5 years of experience in content creation, social media, or digital marketing -ideally within the beauty, fashion, or lifestyle industry. You have experience with Shopify and e-commerce. 

• You have a strong sense of visual storytelling, branding, and aesthetics. 

• You’re skilled in photography, videography, and editing tools. 

• You understand social media trends and know how to adapt them to a luxury brand voice. 

•  You have experience managing social media, newsletters, and website content. 

• You’re proactive, detail-oriented, and full of ideas. 

• You’re fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You understand influencer marketing and community building. 

• You have a deep passion for beauty, design, and lifestyle experiences.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

As a warehouse worker in Wevelgem, you will be involved in the entire logistics process, from receiving to shipping goods. Every day, you use an electric pallet truck, forklift, and handheld scanner. You make sure everything is stored properly, orders are ready on time, and the warehouse stays tidy.
Your day starts between 7 and 8 AM, depending on your training. You pick orders, load and unload trucks and containers, and handle the administrative tasks related to shipments. For this, you use a PC, printer, and ERP system. You carry out simple visual checks and make sure everything runs safely and according to company guidelines. You actively participate in the daily team meeting with your colleagues and support each other.
Ready to roll up your sleeves and feel at home in a warehouse? Apply quickly and make a difference in a growing company!

You speak and write fluent Dutch (preferably), and/or English and/or French.You have a certificate for electric pallet truck and forklift.Experience in a warehouse environment is a plus.You work accurately and with a focus on quality.You are flexible and have a hands-on attitude.You enjoy working in a team and communicate respectfully.You actively participate in the daily team meeting.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Representative, you will work Monday to Friday in rotating shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

• Answer phone calls and emails from customers and partners.

• Collect and verify information.

• Provide technical support and maintain contact with repair workshops.

• Keep customers and all involved parties informed in a timely manner.

• Follow up on agreements and ensure all information is correctly processed in the customer file.

• You speak and write Polish, German, and English fluently to assist our customers effectively.

• You are comfortable working with computer systems and can multitask.

• You have strong communication skills and can handle phone calls and emails professionally.

• You are solution-oriented and always strive to provide the best support to customers.

Dive into a dynamic role where your skills in mechanical assembly will keep everything in its rightful place. As a Pre-Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the meticulous assembly and disassembly of tooling on our state-of-the-art roll forming lines. Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

A typical day sees you inspecting your own work for precision, collaborating with team members, and operating both conventional and CNC-controlled machines. You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Eagerness to learn, conscientiousness, and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and safely

• Flexibility and willingness to work in a 2-shift system

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, order, and cleanliness

• Technical background or equivalent experience

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

• Eagerness to learn with a conscientious and responsible approach

• Strict adherence to safety rules and flexibility in working hours

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

To strengthen our Supply Chain Team we are looking for a Configuration & Logistics Officer who ensures that for a given engine, the pieces are made available for assembly within the configuration and timeframe agreed with the customer.Your role:

• You will analyse and provide the logistical needs to complete the engine.
• You read and understand the logistical aspects of the Bill of Work for the engine.
• You detect critical points in the completion process and look for an appropriate solution to achieve the objectives (e.g. Standard Exchanges, switches between different engines).
• You direct your internal suppliers (warehouse, backshop, subcontracting, purchasing).
• You complete the modules and ensure that they are prepared according to the predetermined production planning.
• You support the assembly line with missing and/or defective parts.
• You analyse the interchangeability (technical and qualitative) of pieces, in accordance with the established configuration.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain or a technical direction, or equivalent through experience.
• You have an interest in aircraft engines and want to learn more about them.
• You are communicative and dare to ask questions.
• You work in a structured, accurate and proactive way.
• You work analytically and come up with practical solutions.
• You organize, divide and control your work independently.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• You work in shifts, from Monday to Friday (6 am - 2 pm, 2 pm - 10 pm).

The Logistic Warehouse Officer is responsible for the physical flow, the IT flow and the traceability of parts and modules in the preparation area before assembly and in the warehouse. He works in a production environment and reports to the Completion Manager, who in turn reports to the Supply Chain Director.Your role:

• You provide logistical support for production, where needed, and anticipate the needs for the realization of the 'Shop Visit' of modules and engines.
• You manage the incoming flow of engine parts in production by ensuring their traceability.
• You ensure the management of priorities vis-à-vis the modules to be prepared and released.
• You guarantee the cleanliness and correct packaging of the parts in the store.
• You follow the work and safety instructions specific to the workstation and the company.
• You respect the internal quality regulations and the rules of logistics and administrative management of the company.

• You strive to become fully operational and autonomous within six months, following a period of training and learning.
• You possess strong communication skills, practical thinking, and initiative, while actively contributing to continuous improvement efforts.
• You are a team player with an open and adaptable mindset.
• You work in a two-shift system: one week from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m., followed by a week from 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.
